# Gelabber v0.8.3

Integrated through #395 into `v0.8` and the version PR into `main`.

A web interface release: the call's connection view and the Voice & Video
dialog. No database migration, no `.env`, `compose.yaml` or `Caddyfile`
changes beyond the image pins. The API and media server change only their
version.

## Connection at a glance

- **Popover on the bars.** The four bars in the call bar now open a small
  popover instead of the dialog: how the connection is, ping and packet
  loss, the ping of the last minute, and what you send and receive. From
  there "Alle Details" opens the diagnostics and "Einstellungen" the audio
  settings. On phones it is a bottom sheet.
- **Diagnostics answer first.** The "Diagnose" tab starts with the same
  status and 90 seconds of ping, coloured where the call gets weak. Below
  it is one table of what is sent and received: everyone's voice in one
  row, a camera's layers in one row, and a note when the browser holds a
  video back for CPU or bandwidth. Media that is not running no longer
  shows up as an empty section.
- The microphone's processing reads as label and value pairs. Codecs,
  priorities, transports, the figures per flow, history and events stay
  available under "Für die Fehlersuche", and the export is now "Diagnose
  herunterladen".
- When a weak call loses packets on the way out, the tab points to the
  economy mode.

## Voice & Video dialog

- The dialog is wider (40rem) and opens with focus on the tab it shows,
  not on "Audio".
- **Rows.** Every setting has its name on the left and its control on the
  right; on phones and narrow settings pages they stack.
- **Audio** is split into input (microphone, gain, push-to-talk, the
  filter as cards) and output (speaker, volumes, call sounds). Echo and
  filters stay behind a disclosure.
- **Video & Stream** is split into camera, Live and upload. Each heading
  shows the current choice. The economy mode now sits only under upload,
  since it limits what you send.

## Upgrade notes

- Image pins `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to `v0.8.3`.
  The order does not matter for this release.
- Rollback: the v0.8.2 image set, all three together. The database is
  unchanged.
- **Desktop, Windows:** the installer and `latest.json` are attached to this
  release; older apps offer the update.
- **Desktop, Linux (Arch):** update from the pacman repository.

## Open

- The new views were checked with recorded figures in both theme styles
  and at phone width, not yet in a real call.
